// Issue #138: Traumatize mills half the library, rounded down.
//
// Sixteen cards on the play. The four nonlands cannot crowd five lands out
// of any eleven, so the drop is made every turn and Traumatize's {3}{U}{U}
// is paid on turn 5 whenever it is in hand by then: among the first eleven
// cards, 11/16. The library is then five cards, and it mills two of them.
12x Island [Land]
1x Traumatize [Mill]
3x Cid, Timeless Artificer [Cid]
